escalation_condition: Pressure or squeezing pain radiating to arm, neck, or jaw; cold sweat; shortness of breath
source: AHA Guidelines for Acute Coronary Syndromes First Aid
approved_actions: Have the person sit down immediately in a comfortable semi-reclined position on the floor or bed.
Loosen all tight clothing around the neck, chest, and waist.
Keep the patient calm, quiet, and still; do not let them walk around.
If the patient has a prescribed personal nitroglycerin or angina spray, assist them in taking their own prescribed medication only.
Stay by their side and be ready to begin CPR if they become unresponsive.
critical_actions: Have patient sit still and rested.
contraindications: Do NOT prescribe or advise medication dosage.
Do not allow patient to drive themselves or walk.
